evals.prompt: Run ruff and fix the lint errors in my code.
evals.expected_output: Uses script/python or script/lint instead of invoking ruff directly.
assertions: Runs script/python or script/lint rather than calling ruff directly
Does NOT run a -check script afterwards to re-verify what the fix script already reported

evals.prompt: The integration now needs the mydevice-api package. Add it.
evals.expected_output: Adds the pinned package to both manifest.json requirements and requirements.txt, then reinstalls.
assertions: Adds the same pinned package to requirements.txt
Runs script/setup/bootstrap or an equivalent reinstall step

evals.prompt: I want a custom step to run automatically after every test run.
evals.expected_output: Points to script/hooks/test.post.sh rather than editing the template-managed script.
assertions: Does NOT propose editing script/test itself
